title: Linked issues for a Copilot PR come from closingIssuesReferences, not the webhook payload
answers: how does the copilot-agent workflow find the issues a Copilot PR is linked to
closing keyword vs assigned-to-Copilot issue link for notifications
notify linked issues when Copilot opens a pull request
body:
Invariant: the set of issues a Copilot PR resolves must be fetched with GraphQL pullRequest.closingIssuesReferences(first: 10); the pull_request_target payload does not include it.
Enforced: .github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml, job comment-on-linked-issues, run step (the gh api graphql query and its --jq filter).
Intended coverage: closing keywords in the PR body and the native link created by assigning the issue to Copilot (PR description and author reply). A reviewer disputed the cited source for a limitation; no in-repo file was verified to say otherwise.
What breaks: parsing 'Fixes #N' from the PR body alone misses assignment-created links.
Caveat: first: 10 caps how many linked issues are notified.
applies: Linked-issue lookup in the copilot-agent workflow; any change to how issues are discovered must keep this query as the source.
says: Assigned issues are not notified when the automated assistant opens a pull request.
Pull request comments fail to appear on issues that were assigned to the bot.
Notify tickets linked by direct bot assignment in addition to closing description keywords.
Only the first ten connected issues receive notification comments from the new pull request.
search: In `.github/workflows/copilot-agent.yml`, the `comment-on-linked-issues` job must query resolved issues via GraphQL `pullRequest.closingIssuesReferences(first: 10)` rather than the `pull_request_target` payload. This query covers closing keywords in the pull request body and direct issue assignment to Copilot, whereas parsing keywords alone misses assignment links. Discovered issues are capped at ten by `first: 10`.
